'''Alsera''' is the Wise One to [[Bruan]], clan chief of the [[Nakai]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Alsera}}

== Activities ==
She informs [[Seana]] through [[Dreamwalking]] that the Nakai Aiel will run all the way from [[Shiagi Hold]] to [[Alcair Dal]] to get there on time.{{Ref/book|4|49}}
